label: Account Executive

anchors.title: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Technical and Scientific Products

core_tasks: Identify prospective customers and qualify leads
Negotiate prices and terms of sale
Prepare and present proposals to buyers
Maintain records of accounts and pipeline

sources.reading: Ten-year headcount outlook, not skill demand.

linked_roles.note: Separate linked role. Owns hiring and coaching of AEs. Not part of this IC ladder.

levels.name: Sales Development Rep
levels.scope: Outbound prospecting and qualifying. Quota is meetings booked, not revenue.
levels.owns: A meetings target and a list of target accounts.

expectations.label: Prospecting cadences across email, phone and social

levels.name: SMB / Associate AE
levels.scope: Full cycle on small, fast deals. High volume, short cycles, one or two buyers.
levels.owns: A revenue quota on transactional deals.
levels.step_up: Closes revenue instead of handing meetings off. Runs demos and pricing conversations alone.

expectations.label: Product demos tailored to one buyer
Prospecting cadences across email, phone and social

levels.name: Mid-Market AE
levels.scope: Book of named accounts. Several stakeholders per deal, 30 to 90 day cycles.
levels.owns: A book of business and a new-business quota.
levels.step_up: Sells to a buying group, not one buyer. Builds the business case and forecasts by deal stage.

expectations.label: ROI and business-case building with finance buyers
Mutual action plans and stage-accurate forecasting

levels.name: Enterprise AE
levels.scope: Large accounts with procurement, security and legal review. 6 to 12 month cycles.
levels.owns: A seven-figure quota across a small set of large accounts.
levels.step_up: Runs a deal team of SEs, partners and execs. Navigates procurement and legal, not only the buyer.

expectations.label: Orchestrating SEs, partners and internal execs

levels.name: Strategic AE
levels.scope: A handful of the company's largest accounts. Multi-year, multi-product agreements.
levels.owns: Long-term account strategy for named strategic customers.
levels.step_up: Shapes multi-year account strategy and complex deal structures. Builds internal coalitions to win.

expectations.label: C-level relationships at customer and internally

limits: Fixture data from the illustrative Role Atlas prototype; not research findings.
Core measurement windows repeat the prototype's steady peak share, using the role-wide employer count as an illustrative assumption, not measured level-specific employer coverage.
The prototype omits edge employer counts: eight is an explicit fixture-only assumption, not an observation.
Window employer concentration is the prototype's illustrative 20% cap, not measured employer allocation.
Counts describe the admitted sample in each window, not the whole market.
Posting frequency is not importance, proficiency or hiring likelihood.
Industry splits are only as wide as the employers sampled in each industry.
Forecast probabilities and base rates are illustrative; no backtest has been run.
